events.text: Let's recap.
Number one.
On Airbnb, you have fourteen days from the guest's checkout to start a damage request in the Resolution Centre.
Document first, then file.
Number two.
Host damage protection covers a lot, up to three million American dollars, but Airbnb says it isn't insurance, and it doesn't cover wear and tear or routine cleaning.
Number three.
Know your cancellation policy before a guest cancels.
And if you have to cancel, contact Airbnb Support with your evidence before you press the button.
Number four.
Tell your insurer before you list, ask what's covered while it's rented, and keep the answer in writing.
And number five.
Photograph before you clean, keep your receipts, and set a reminder on checkout day.
That's episode three of the Keegix Podcast.
